name: ai-strategist
description: Interviews you about your business and your life, then designs the AI hub that runs them: which Claude Projects to create, what each one reads, and what runs on a schedule. Runs as a Quick Plan or as the full interview, and labels every capability line it could not check.

interface.shortDescription: Design the AI hub that runs your business and your life
interface.longDescription: Interviews you about every business and life area you carry, then writes one Hub Strategy document: which Claude Projects to create, what each one reads, the skills and plugins it needs, what runs on a schedule, and where the results land in your Notion hub. Run it as a Quick Plan or as the full interview. The full interview checks capabilities against current documentation while you sit there; the Quick Plan does not stop to look anything up, so its lines come to you labeled unverified and are re-checked in the session that builds from them. It builds nothing without you.
defaultPrompt: Help me set up my Notion hub.
What would you need to know to plan my projects?
